# M9: the external test package of a loGo/s package (package foo_test) gets
# the lint policy of its module, like the package itself and its internal
# tests: logos test fails on a deny or forbid finding in it, and
# //logos:allow silences a deny finding there.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Control: an internal test file is linted by logos test.
cd internal
! logos test ./...
stderr 'in_test\.lgo:5:6: \[correctness::infinite_recursion\]'
cd ..

# A forbid finding in an external test file fails logos test.
cd xtest
! logos test ./forbid
stderr 'x_test\.lgo:5:6: \[correctness::infinite_recursion\]'
! stdout '^ok'

# A deny finding in an external test file fails logos test.
! logos test ./deny
stderr 'x_test\.lgo:9:2: \[slop::discarded_error\]'
! stdout '^ok'

# The directive silences the deny finding in an external test file, and the
# test runs.
logos test ./allowed
stdout '^ok'
! stderr 'slop::discarded_error'

# logos.toml slop = "allow" is silent in an external test file, and the
# severity of the table reaches it.
cp logos-allow.toml logos.toml
logos test ./deny
stdout '^ok'
! stderr 'slop::discarded_error'
cd ..

-- internal/go.mod --
module example.com/internal

go 1.27

-- internal/foo.lgo --
package foo

func Name() string { return "foo" }

-- internal/in_test.lgo --
package foo

import "testing"

func loop(n int) int {
	return loop(n)
}

func TestName(t *testing.T) {
	if Name() != "foo" {
		t.Fatal("bad name")
	}
}

-- xtest/go.mod --
module example.com/xtest

go 1.27

-- xtest/logos-allow.toml --
[lints]
slop = "allow"

-- xtest/forbid/foo.lgo --
package foo

func Name() string { return "foo" }

-- xtest/forbid/x_test.lgo --
package foo_test

import "testing"

func loop(n int) int {
	return loop(n)
}

func TestName(t *testing.T) {
	t.Log("ran")
}

-- xtest/deny/foo.lgo --
package foo

func Name() string { return "foo" }

-- xtest/deny/x_test.lgo --
package foo_test

import (
	"os"
	"testing"
)

func TestName(t *testing.T) {
	os.Remove("missing")
}

-- xtest/allowed/foo.lgo --
package foo

func Name() string { return "foo" }

-- xtest/allowed/x_test.lgo --
package foo_test

import (
	"os"
	"testing"
)

func TestName(t *testing.T) {
	//logos:allow(slop::discarded_error)
	os.Remove("missing")
}
